t: The Evolution of Web Navigation: Building an Interactive Table of Contents with Tocbot
s: Web Tables of Contents (ToCs) have evolved from static, manually created lists to dynamic, interactive navigational tools. Modern ToCs, often built client-side using libraries like Tocbot, significantly enhance user experience by providing scannability, accessibility, and contextual awareness through features like scroll-spying and smooth scrolling.
